name: House cleaner

pf.license.need: Usually none for house cleaning. Where the state's or city's rules require a license or a business registration, the form asks for it.
pf.license.ask: The company's business registration or local business license number, where the form asks for one.
pf.license.who_holds: The business. Cleaners need no license of their own unless the state's form says so.
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never looks up, checks or confirms a license, insurance or registration (D96); anything shown is as given by the business, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.blocks_live: nothing waits on a license (D96): the business and each person go live once set up and the owner says yes; a job the owner says needs a license they don't have isn't booked
pf.license.insurance_bond: Insured or bonded is shown as given by the business, not checked by Rosie.
pf.license.background_checks: Only where the state's rules require them, or as the business's own word.
pf.license.not_this_work: Mold removal over the state's size cutoff, and home care (meals, errands, company for an older or disabled person), are licensed in some states. They aren't house cleaning.

pf.services.pattern: Set service: a fixed service at the customer's place, often repeating, priced by the home's size.

list.name: Deep clean
list.price_kind: set by the customer's answers (bedrooms, bathrooms, square feet)
list.example: 3 bed, 2 bath: $179 (the example business's own price)
list.length: set by the home's size: about 3 hours for a crew of two
list.money: card saved at booking; charged at DONE

list.name: Standard clean
list.length: about 2 hours for a crew of two

list.name: Plan visits (standard clean)
list.price_kind: a per-visit price for each plan
list.example: every 1, 2 or 4 weeks: $125, $135 or $145 a visit
list.where: at the customer's place; nobody needs to be home
list.money: card saved; each visit charged at its own DONE

list.name: Move-out clean
list.price_kind: quoted from the customer's photos first
list.where: at the customer's place, an empty home
list.money: card saved, or a deposit where the state's caps allow; the rest charged at DONE

list.name: Heavy clean
list.price_kind: quoted at the visit, before any work (a home not cleaned in a long time)
list.example: only the $89 visit fee is promised

list.name: Window washing (the second kind of work)
list.example: inside windows $149; inside and outside $189 (the example business's own prices); skylights and high windows: a free estimate, then a quote
list.where: at the customer's place; outside only: nobody needs to be home
list.weather: outside work has a weather limit Sam sets (rain or high wind); a move for weather is free

list.name: By the hour
list.example: $120 an hour for a crew of two, 1-hour minimum

list.name: Add-ons
list.price_kind: one price each, added only when the customer asks
list.example: inside the oven and fridge $160; inside windows $95; carpet shampoo $199

list.name: Visit fee
list.example: $89: only for a late cancel or a lockout the owner confirms, or owed when a heavy clean isn't done

list.name: Rug and curtain care at the business
list.price_kind: one price by size, from photos, or at the counter
list.example: small rug $35, runner $40, cushion covers $20, bath mat $25, curtains $55, 8x10 rug $140, stain removal from photos, antique rug priced at the counter after a $25 inspection
list.where: dropped off at the business; a rug can also be washed at the customer's home ($75)
list.money: nothing taken; paid at the counter at pick-up

pf.services.capacity: A home clean takes a crew of two: a lead and a helper. A drop-off needs one person at the counter.
pf.services.nobody_home: Yes, for plan visits: entry by lockbox, door code or a key the business holds. DONE with after photos confirms it.
pf.services.not_offered: Mold over the state's size cutoff, sewage, biohazards, home care. Outside windows only under window washing.
pf.services.drop_off_slots: Rugs and curtains are booked into drop-off slots by the shop's daily number, with no rug cleaner named; the rug goes to a rug cleaner with the skill once it's in.

before_times: Bedrooms, bathrooms and about how many square feet
Was the home cleaned by a professional in the last 30 days? (sets deep or standard)
Just once, or a plan every 1, 2 or 4 weeks
For window washing: inside, outside or both, and how many floors
For a drop-off: the rug's size and what it's made of
after_a_time: Surfaces that need care, like marble or unsealed wood
Rooms to skip or focus on
secure_page_only: How the crew gets in: lockbox, door code, garage code or a key the business holds
Why a product must be avoided, like an allergy
pf.questions.who_may_book: An adult who lives in the home, or the owner, a landlord or a property manager they name (a move-out clean).

words: mold patch over the state's size cutoff
floors or stairs that aren't safe to walk
what_happens: Mold over the cutoff, sewage or biohazards: Rosie says a cleaner can't take that on and points to a specialist. The rest of the home can still be booked with that area left out.
Sewage: keep children and pets away, and stay out if it's near outlets.
A gas smell: leave and call 911. No booking until it's safe.
Bedbugs or rodents: pest control comes first; the clean is booked after.
Care help (meals, errands, company) isn't cleaning: no booking, and the AI can look for a home-care agency.
pf.safety.booking_goes_on: Yes, with the area left out (mold, sewage, biohazards). No, for home care or a gas smell.

pf.first_steps.first_clean: A new home's first clean is a deep clean, unless a professional cleaned it in the last 30 days.
pf.first_steps.plan: A plan starts after the first clean. Cancelling the first clean also ends the plan that starts after it, and the customer is told first.
pf.first_steps.photos: A move-out clean is priced from the customer's photos first.
prep_for_reminder: Leave the entry code on the secure page, not in a text
pf.first_steps.rug_dye_test: Stain removal and antique rugs: a short dye test at the shop first, so the colors won't run in the wash (the example: 15 minutes, at least 2 days before; it stays good for 3 months).

pf.visit.check_in: Someone home: the code at the door, entered by the crew lead. Nobody home (most plan visits): no code; the lead opens the lockbox or door code.
pf.visit.entry_codes: Shown only to the crew lead, only on the visit day, and each opening is logged. The key goes back in the lockbox at the end.
pf.visit.lockout: No way in when nobody needs to be home (a lockbox, door or garage code fails): the crew lead texts it, Alex gets a link for a new code, and the crew waits 30 minutes, then leaves. A lockout fee only if the owner confirms it.
pf.visit.drop_off: At the business: the code is given at the counter when the rug or curtains are left. Status words IN, DRYING, READY. READY comes with a photo. Pick-up only by the customer or someone they name.
pf.visit.changes_at_visit: Add-ons only when the customer asks, priced before they're done. A heavy clean is priced before any work. A right to cancel where the state's rules give one.
pf.visit.proof_done: Before photos, a room-by-room checklist, after photos from the same angles. DONE with after photos when nobody's home.
pf.visit.breakage: Reported with photos the same day; the owner decides how to make it right.

pf.money.start: House cleaning: a card saved at booking, charged at DONE. Drop-offs: nothing taken, paid at the counter at pick-up.
pf.money.deposits: None by default. Sam can set a deposit or the full price per service, within the state's caps (the example: a 25% deposit on a move-out clean priced from photos). Deposit cap: from the state form.
pf.money.fees: Late cancel and lockout: the business's own fee (the example: $89), never more than the visit's price. The owner confirms each one; no answer, no fee.
pf.money.plans: Each plan visit is charged at its own DONE. Rosfield's $2 counts once a month for a plan.
pf.money.tips: Optional, all to the crew. A tip line only if the owner turns it on. How card tips are handled follows the state's rules, from the state form.
pf.money.tax: A sales tax line only where the state taxes house cleaning, from the state form.

never_in_texts: Entry, lockbox, door, garage and alarm codes
Health reasons, like an allergy behind a product to avoid
pf.messages.photos: Photos of the home go only to the customer and the business.
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish. The crew's language shows on the job.
pf.messages.minors: Nobody under 18 books. A teen at home isn't the booking's adult.

skills: Rug washing, stain removal, antique rugs
pf.staff.crews: Two per home clean: a lead, who holds the entry code and texts DONE, and a helper.
pf.staff.licenses: None per person unless the state's form says so.
pf.staff.new_person_ok: A cleaner the customer hasn't booked is offered by text first, never sent without an OK. No answer: the rest of the booked crew comes and the clean takes about an hour longer, or it moves with no fee.
pf.staff.who_oks: The owner OKs quotes over the limit. The office manager may too; the owner's answer wins.

plans: The plan's terms show before any card is asked: how often, the price a visit, when it's charged, that it runs until ended, and how to end it.
The plan gets its own yes, apart from the booking, and the terms are texted back.
A price change is told 30 days ahead, or more where the state's rules ask.
Any reminder the state's rules require for a running plan.
pf.rules.add_on_at_home: A right to cancel where the state's rules give one for work sold at the home.
pf.rules.written_contract: Above an amount, where the state's rules require it.
pf.rules.landlord: A move-out clean booked by a renter may need the landlord's or manager's OK.
pf.rules.records: 7 years, with the before and after photos.

matter_most: Lockout: a code that fails when nobody needs to be home. The crew waits 30 minutes, then leaves; the owner decides any fee.
Something breaks during the clean: photos the same day; the owner decides.
Missed spots: tell the business within 24 hours; a free re-clean of those areas within 48 hours. A redo, never money from Rosie.
A crew member is out: a new person is offered first; no answer, the rest of the crew comes for longer.
Skip, pause or end a plan, and a plan's price change.
Mold or sewage found during the clean: that area stops; a written note goes to the customer.
A rug or curtains not picked up: reminders; after the free days, a storage fee only if the owner starts it, after written notice.
Weather over the limit for outside window washing: Sam keeps the visit or moves it, with no fee.
Several open bookings (a plan's next visits): which one is asked first.
pf.edges.rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.

Where a state has no data feed, a person on Rosie's team checks the state's own site and keeps a screenshot.

Flow B is the usual side: Lee Home Cleaning (house cleaning, plus window washing as its second kind of work). Flow A is the less usual side: Lee Rug Care, Sam's second company, where customers drop off rugs and curtains and pick them up clean.
Second kind of work: window washing, not a licensed trade, so nothing is invented about licenses. House cleaning, window washing and rug care need no state license where Sam works; the sign-up and team license steps say so and check the company's business registration instead (the plug-in's default). Where a state's form asks for one, the same steps ask for it.
Names: Jordan and Casey become crew leads Robin and Jamie; Riley and Avery become rug cleaners Rowan and Sasha. They're neutral names, so every he, she or they in the master still fits. Addresses: 17 Birch Ln, 500 Lake St, 64 Pine St.
Every master number is kept, so sums, deposits and refunds still add up: $179 deep clean, $150 standard clean, $640 move-out clean from photos, $245 heavy clean priced at the visit, $89 visit fee, $35 small rug wash, $55 curtains, $140 large rug, $90 stain removal, $25 inspection.
The old flowchart's $50 late-cancel and $75 lockout fees became one $89 visit fee, so the master's single fee reads right. The old 48-hour free-cancel window is left to Sam's booking rules (the master's 7am the day of the visit).
Main money: B is list|card|card (a card saved, charged at DONE), the way cleaners are paid. A is list|none|counter (nothing taken, paid at the counter at pick-up). Only the combinations the work really uses are listed.

The plan's terms and own yes are the master's now (B5-20, B5-21: G8); a words op gives B5-21 the cleaner's plan, and the own B6-x01 still texts the terms back.
